description: This file defines the ImageFetcher class, a utility for fetching and resizing images from URLs, with caching mechanisms and network connection handling, used within an Android application.

classes.name: ImageFetcher
classes.description: A subclass of ImageResizer that fetches images from a URL, resizes them, and manages an HTTP cache for efficient loading.

methods.name: ImageFetcher
methods.description: Constructs an ImageFetcher with specified width and height, initializes network and cache settings.

methods.name: ImageFetcher
methods.description: Constructs an ImageFetcher with a square size, initializes cache.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes network connection checking and cache directory.

methods.name: initDiskCacheInternal
methods.description: Initializes disk cache by calling super and setting up HTTP disk cache.

methods.name: initHttpDiskCache
methods.description: Creates and opens the HTTP cache directory with a specified size.

methods.name: clearCacheInternal
methods.description: Clears both main and HTTP caches.

methods.name: flushCacheInternal
methods.description: Flushes the HTTP cache to persistent storage.

methods.name: closeCacheInternal
methods.description: Closes and nullifies the HTTP cache.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks for active network connection and shows a toast if none is found.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Downloads and decodes a bitmap from a URL with caching, executed in background thread.

methods.name: processBitmap
methods.description: Overridden method that takes an object, converts to String URL, and fetches bitmap.

methods.name: downloadUrlToStream
methods.description: Downloads image data from URL and writes to the provided output stream.

methods.name: disableConnectionReuseIfNecessary
methods.description: Sets system property to disable HTTP connection reuse on pre-Froyo Android versions.
